category_title: Third-grade students with E/BD exhibiting externalizing disruptive behaviors during reading
minimal_context: The student is participating in a small group reading activity in a third-grade classroom.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Alright everyone, let's open our books and take turns reading the first paragraph for our group work.

STUDENT: (Laughs loudly) Hey, who wants to talk about the new video game instead of this?

TUTOR: Let's get back to the reading assignment, please.

STUDENT: (Whining) I don't want to read right now. I'm not doing it.

TUTOR: You need to participate with your group.

STUDENT: I said I'm not doing this stupid work! (Starts talking loudly to another student while the teacher is talking) Hey, ignore them, let's talk about the game!

options.A: Encourage the student to examine the cover and read the first pages of the book.
options.B: Facilitate group talk in strategic ways to lead the student to search for text evidence.
options.C: Provide feedback on the student's progress report throughout the day's reading activities.
options.D: Agree with the student that they are having a rough time during the reading activity.
